params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: { panes?: ('nav'|'aside')[], navLabel?, mainLabel?, asideLabel?, asideOpen?, label? }.

params.name: OnAction
params.note: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked; Key is its key.

notes: New component: App framework step 7 (issue #353). The element's mount(panes) callback hands the app pane elements that live in a shadow tree, so the Blazor panes are slots instead (issue #1415): NavContent, ChildContent (main) and AsideContent are rendered as light-DOM children the element projects into its panes; Config panes lists the optional panes to create.
